result.summary: The food delivery home screen is largely well-rendered, but one clear defect stands out: the 'Fastest near you' carousel shows a duplicated restaurant card (Green Bowl Poké appears twice with identical image, ETA and delivery fee). Other observations are minor.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel lists 'Green Bowl Poké' twice as the first two cards, with identical image, '15–25 min' badge and '€0.90 delivery' text. This looks like a data duplication or list-rendering bug and wastes a slot that should show a different restaurant.
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate restaurants by ID before rendering the carousel and verify the data source/pagination logic so each card represents a unique restaurant.

issues.description: Light grey placeholder and secondary text (search placeholder, '€0.90 delivery', bottom nav labels) has relatively low contrast against the white/light backgrounds.
issues.suggestion: Darken secondary text colors slightly to meet WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1) for small text.
